remarks: Welcome to 507 Elysian Blvd, a charming fully furnished mountain retreat offering 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and approximately 760 sq. ft. This inviting home features warm wood-paneled walls and ceilings, a beautiful floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, comfortable living areas, and a functional kitchen with granite countertops, ample cabinetry, and a gas range. The home offers a spacious primary bedroom and a second bedroom. Step outside to a fenced backyard with a beautiful covered wood deck, perfect for relaxing and enjoying the peaceful surroundings, plus a detached storage shed.
